description: Create one ordinary table in the public schema of a Dev or Prod database, as the migration role with the same access as migration tables, so a database_watch_create can attach later. Each column has a lower-case name, a type (text, integer, bigint, boolean, numeric, double precision, timestamptz, date, uuid or jsonb) and optional nullable, identity (integer or bigint only) and default (now for timestamptz, uuid for uuid); at most 64 columns, 8 primary-key columns and 100 tables per database. An identical repeat answers created: false; a table of the same name with another definition is refused with database_table_conflict. Tables created this way are not in the repository's migration files: record them in project notes and add a migration when the source should reproduce the database. Requires confirmed: true and an idempotency key. Refused with project_budget_exceeded while the Stop budget is reached.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
